channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: India's internet users cross 1.02 billion: TRAI
item.description: The total number of internet subscribers increased from 1,017.81 million at the end of September 2025 to 1,028.61 million by the end of December 2025, registering a quarterly growth of 1.06 per cent.

item.title: When will US‑Israel‑Iran war stop?
item.description: US President Trump and Israeli PM Netanyahu said the conflict could last weeks but is unlikely to be prolonged. India called for de-escalation, opposed attacks on merchant ships, and prioritized the safety of nearly one crore Indians in the Gulf.

item.title: Schools, universities shut; 2G restrictions continue in Kashmir amid protests over Ayatollah Ali Khamenei killing
item.description: Amid widespread protests in Jammu and Kashmir following the killing of Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, the Union Territory government has ordered the closure of all educational institutions, including universities, till March 7 as a precautionary measure.

item.title: Omar Abdullah sounds alert: 'Don't Let Khamenei protests be hijacked by anti-national forces'
item.description: Amid anti-US and anti-Israel protests across the Union Territory over the killing of Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah appealed for calm and restraint, warning that anti-national elements were attempting to exploit the charged atmosphere to create law-and-order problems.

item.title: IPL 2026: RCB confirms it will host five matches at Chinnaswamy Stadium; two games at Raipur
item.description: Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB) will host five of their home matches for IPL 2026 at the M. Chinnaswamy Stadium in Bengaluru, with the remaining two games played at Raipur. The Karnataka government has cleared the stadium for matches following the previous year's tragic stamped

item.title: Rashmika wears sindoor, mangalsutra for lunch date with Vijay; fans say 'their never-ending post-wedding appearances'
item.description: Newlyweds Rashmika Mandanna and Vijay Deverakonda, married on February 26 in Udaipur, the couple dropped Sangeet photos featuring family dances. On Tuesday, the couple hosted a meet-and-greet event for fans.

item.title: Sensex down by over 1,700 points; Nifty Slips 500 as markets crash over oil concerns
item.description: Indian markets opened sharply lower on Wednesday as rising tensions in the Middle East triggered broad risk-off sentiment. The Nifty dropped more than 530 points (around 2.1%) to hover near 24,300, while the Sensex fell over 1,700 points (2.15%) to about 78,493.

item.title: Drone strike near US Consulate in Dubai; visa, consular appointments cancelled
item.description: A drone strike near the US Consulate in Dubai caused a fire but no injuries were reported. The incident comes amid a series of drone and missile attacks targeting US diplomatic missions across the Middle East, including Kuwait and Riyadh, marking an escalation of regional hostilities.

item.title: Beijing, Moscow signal support for Iran but avoid confrontation with US: Report
item.description: A recent report says that both Beijing and Moscow are signaling support for Iran amid the widening Middle East conflict, but their backing is mostly symbolic and deliberately cautious rather than substantive.

item.title: Mojtaba, son of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, chosen as Iran's new Supreme Leader: Report
item.description: Iran's clerical body has reportedly selected Mojtaba Khamenei, son of late Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei, as the country's new paramount authority, Iran International said. The Assembly of Experts allegedly backed his appointment after Ali Khamenei's reported death in US-Israel strikes, with claims the Revolutionary Guard played a decisive role.
